# Voice fixtures

Short **text-to-speech** clips (not human recordings): `en` and `de` made with macOS `say` (Samantha, Anna), `ar-neural` and
`bn-neural` with Microsoft Edge neural voices (`ar-EG-SalmaNeural`, `bn-BD-NabanitaNeural`) through `edge-tts`, converted to 16 kHz mono
16-bit WAV with `afconvert`. The reference sentences are in `references.json`. `docs/VOICE.md` has the measured error rates.
